meta.title: Inline runtime value conversions
meta.body_summary: Reduce helper function calls by adding Value.ToAny and FromAny methods to the runtime value type and updating VM code to use these new methods directly.

core_change_summary.description: Added Value.ToAny and Value.FromAny methods in runtime/vm/value.go and replaced existing conversion helper calls in runtime/vm/vm.go and runtime/vm/liveness.go with direct method invocations, eliminating helper function overhead.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Liveness.go had a trivial 2-line update to use the new method.
